name: BCG Matrix
excerpt: The BCG Matrix evaluates business units based on growth rates and market share.
notes: The BCG Matrix is a tool used to evaluate business units based on their growth rates and market share. It categorizes units into Stars (high growth, high market share), Question Marks (high growth, low market share), Cash Cows (low growth, high market share), and Dogs (low growth, low market share).
context_summary:
- Evaluates business units based on growth rates
- Assesses market share
- Categorizes units into Stars, Question Marks, Cash Cows, and Dogs
